image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a white composite flower (likely an Osteospermum or African Daisy) with broad, rounded white petals. The center features a distinct dark purple/blue ring surrounding a textured orange-yellow disc. Green foliage and unopened buds are visible in the blurred background.
